entities.name: Grand Duke Alexei Mikhailovich of Russia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Grand Duke Alexei Mikhailovich of Russia was the sixth son and youngest child of Grand Duke Michael Nicolaievich of Russia and a first cousin of Alexander III of Russia. He was destined to follow a career in the Russian Navy, but he died in his youth of tuberculosis.
